title.zh: 链上对账：Anubis 与 Polygon 的 LGNS 价差约 4.2 倍
title.en: On-chain check: LGNS trades ~4.2x higher on Polygon than on Anubis

summary.zh: Anubis 主池按 DAI 储备反推约 $0.048，Polygon QuickSwap 主池约 $0.203。两条链使用不同合约，价差反映流动性与兑付通道差异，不代表可以无风险套利。
summary.en: The Anubis pool implies about $0.048 from DAI reserves, while the Polygon QuickSwap pool quotes about $0.203. The tokens are different contracts; the gap reflects liquidity and redemption differences, not risk-free arbitrage.

title.zh: 链上抽样：claimInterest 领取笔数与单笔金额
title.en: On-chain sample: claimInterest claim count and individual amounts

summary.zh: 最近质押合约转出记录中约四成为 claimInterest。单笔金额受大额领取影响，样本窗口很短，只呈现样本事实，不做全天或年化外推。
summary.en: About 40% of recent outgoing transfers from the staking contract were claimInterest. Amounts are skewed by large claims and the sample window is short, so no full-day or annualized estimate is made.

title.zh: 链上持仓：第一大地址控制约 79% 供应，且为可升级代理
title.en: On-chain holdings: top address controls ~79% of supply and is an upgradeable proxy

summary.zh: 该地址是 EIP-1967 代理、未开源，持有约 39 亿 LGNS。剔除合约地址后，最大个人地址占比约 3.2%。
summary.en: The address is an unverified EIP-1967 proxy holding about 3.9B LGNS. Excluding contracts, the largest individual address holds about 3.2%.

title.zh: 媒体质疑：LGNS 价格大幅下跌，Anubis 被指为团队自建链
title.en: Media scepticism: LGNS price slump, Anubis called a team-built chain

summary.zh: 文章称 LGNS 合约可联动外部合约、存在操控空间，并质疑 Anubis 链的去中心化程度。属媒体观点，需自行核实。
summary.en: The article alleges the LGNS contract can call external contracts, creating manipulation surface, and questions how decentralized Anubis really is. Media opinion; verify independently.

title.zh: 官方社区公告：Burn Bond 合约地址将公示
title.en: Official community post: Burn Bond contract address to be published

summary.zh: 公告称销毁与参数调整将通过 DAO 投票，并提示勿点击第三方私链链接。公告内容未在链上验证，本站仅作来源记录。
summary.en: The post says burns and parameter changes will go through DAO votes and warns against third-party links. The content is not verified on-chain; recorded here as a source only.
